notes.title: Optimization Patch
notes.content: Did a passthrough of all in-game textures. Any 4k textures were scaled down to 2k. Normal and Roughness textures were scaled down to 50% and 25% respectively. This modification lowered the overall file size of the game from 3.95gb to 1.54gb. On my personal machine, I see GPU memory consumption range from 3gb to 4.5gb. This should improve overall performance.
